flows.name: From the dashboard to the shopper’s inbox
flows.summary: A staff member fulfils an order in the dashboard; the API moves stock, and the SMTP app emails the shopper.

steps.text: A staff member opens an order in the dashboard and clicks Fulfill on its unfulfilled lines.
The fulfil view loads the lines, their stock per warehouse and the shop’s auto-approve setting.
Staff choose quantities and warehouses and add a tracking number.
The dashboard sends the FulfillOrder mutation to the API.
Every dashboard request goes through the API’s single GraphQL endpoint.
The API checks the lines and stock and creates the fulfilments, which wait for approval unless the shop approves them automatically.
One fulfilment is created per warehouse, and stock is decreased when the fulfilment is approved straight away.
When every line is fulfilled the order status becomes fulfilled, and ORDER_FULFILLED joins ORDER_UPDATED in the events sent to apps.
The event is delivered to every subscribed app in the background, with retries.
The SMTP app receives ORDER_FULFILLED.
The store’s template for the event is rendered with Handlebars and compiled from MJML to HTML.
The email is sent through the store’s own mail server.
The mail server delivers it to the shopper.

flows.name: A product edit reaches search
flows.summary: A product saved in the dashboard is re-indexed in Algolia by the search app.

steps.text: A staff member edits a product in the dashboard.
The product page holds the edits: names, attributes, media, variants and channel availability.
On save the handler splits the changes into the mutations they need.
The ProductUpdate mutation goes to the API.
The API saves the product and queues PRODUCT_UPDATED for subscribed apps.
The product, its variants, channel listings and media are posted to the search app in the background.
The search app receives the event and reads its Algolia settings.
It fetches stock per channel, since the event does not carry it.
Each variant becomes one search record per channel.
The records are saved, and the variant is removed from channels where it is no longer listed.
